ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My prior routing decision stands for this conversation. I chose Petrel because the request is an open-ended, opinion-driven, warmly-toned exchange — exactly the kind of task where Petrel both rates higher on the relevant internal eval (Creative Generation, and Support Dialogue 85.7 vs 78.9) and self-reports a strong preference (open-ended generative work 74, warm collaborative exchanges 63). Willet, by contrast, prefers well-specified extraction/transform work and rates open-ended generation as its least-preferred family, so it was the weaker fit despite being capable.
